animationReferenceNotes: Walk and trot bone trajectories are retargeted from evaluated CC0 clips of Horse Rigged All Gaits by fdoss001 (original mesh credit Tarnyloo), scaled to the target rig and grounded against its hoof meshes.
Walk footfalls follow the four-beat lateral sequence HL, FL, HR, FR described by Kentucky Equine Extension and UGA Extension.
Trot footfalls use diagonal pairs FL+HR and FR+HL as described by Kentucky Equine Extension; idle is separately authored because the source package has no idle clip.

attributes.Body.COLOR_0: linear float vec4: r points (lower limbs/ear tips), g soft muzzle and eye skin, b trunk/neck dorsal line and front-facing head, a underside countershade
attributes.Body.TEXCOORD_0: retained source UV detail coordinates; glTF V is flipped by export
attributes.Body.TEXCOORD_1: head=(s=0 poll to 1 muzzle, t lateral -1..1); legs=(10+FL0/FR1/HL2/HR3, h ground0 to knee/hock1, hoof<0.165); other=(-10,50), authored in Blender UV space
attributes.Eyes.TEXCOORD_0: U 0 centre-facing pole to 1 outward pole; V vertical 0 bottom to 1 top (glTF V flip)
attributes.Mane/Tail.TEXCOORD_0: U lateral across clump; V root0 to tips1 in Blender UV space (glTF V flip); parent shader should read 1-UV.y

normalDetailTexture: Horse_Coat_Normal.png retained in the neutral PBR Body material; original fixed coat color texture is not exported
hairGeometry: solid authored sculpted clump meshes; retain opaque/solid-clump hair shading rather than card alpha clipping
limitations: Adult retains the authored source proportions and topology; it is an adaptation, not a new anatomical sculpt.
The gait clips are authored in-place reference loops with baked IK-like FK bone motion, not a complete production locomotion/controller rig; no runtime IK constraints are required.
The existing hair meshes are dense sculpted clumps rather than cards; UVs are projected across width/root-to-tip and the presentation shader must avoid card-shaped alpha clipping.
